core_obligations: Settle flatness and relative dimension of the composite by the standard composition statement (proof lines 2299-2301).

Reduce to a coefficient comparison: take an integral closed subscheme of the target, an integral subscheme of the middle scheme contained in its preimage, and an integral subscheme of the source contained in the preimage of the latter, with the three delta-dimensions differing by the two relative dimensions, and note that by the dimension statement it suffices to compare the coefficients of the last class in the two pullbacks (proof lines 2302-2313).

Compare the coefficients at the generic points: with the three local rings at the generic points the maps are flat and local, the coefficient in the composite pullback is the length of the source local ring over the expanded maximal ideal of the base, while the coefficient in the iterated pullback is the product of the length over the expanded maximal ideal of the middle ring with the length of the middle ring over the expanded maximal ideal of the base; the equality is the transitivity statement for flat local maps (proof lines 2314-2327).
proof_roadmap: Flatness and relative dimension of the composite (proof lines 2299-2301).
Reduction to one coefficient comparison for a chain of integral subschemes (proof lines 2302-2313).
Length computation at the generic points and transitivity (proof lines 2314-2327).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for two flat morphisms the flat pullback of the composite is the composite of the flat pullbacks, with the expected relative dimension (statement lines 2286-2297, tag 02RD). Flatness and the relative dimension are immediate from the composition statement, but the equality of the operations requires a real coefficient computation: one reduces to a chain of integral closed subschemes related by the two pullbacks, passes to the local rings at the three generic points, and identifies the two coefficients as lengths which are equal by transitivity of the flat length formula. That length comparison is the substance, so the claim is H2.
